PolicyWatch copies of selected Harpeth Conservancy GIS assets.

Included datasets:
- TN county regions
- Justice40 / ATP tracts
- 2026 303(d) impairment layer
- DWR monitoring stations
- Tennessee scenic rivers
- Active water permitted features
- Public water system service area boundaries

These are copied from the larger Harpeth Conservancy maps workspace so this app can rely on stable local inputs without depending on the full external folder structure.
